_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 CONSOLIDATED cross-discipline ground-truth / comparison values. Each discipline section holds Brandt-workbook / Air-Force-manual / internet OUTPUTS that the framework's computed results are compared AGAINST -- these are NOT toolbox inputs (see examples/F16A/*_L*.json for inputs). NEVER backfill a unit-test 'expected' value from anything in this file (self-referential-test trap); the comparison report is informational only.
_source: Brandt-F16-A.xls geometry values + VnV/BrandtF16A/readme_aero.md (Brandt aero, cell refs) + T.O. 1F-16A-1 (AF-manual aero) + cited internet sources (aerodynamics).
_note_columns: Aerodynamics comparison columns are Brandt + AF-Manual (T.O. 1F-16A-1) + internet (no F16Baseline column). Read as the comparison target by examples/F16A/geometry_brandt_comparison.m and aerodynamics_brandt_comparison.m; never backfill a unit-test expected value from this file.

geometry._comment: F-16A Block 10/15 Brandt-workbook ground-truth geometry values, for the Geometry deep-dive's later comparison-report script to check computed L1/L2 toolbox output against (Geometry's L3 tier was eliminated 2026-07-22 and merged into L2 — see src/disciplines/geometry/GeomL2.md's dated note). These are NOT toolbox inputs (see examples/F16A/geometry_L*.json for those) — they are Brandt Geom-tab outputs/validation figures to compare computed results to.
geometry._source: VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/Brandt-F16-A.xls (Geom sheet unless noted); VnV/BrandtF16A/readme_geom.md; VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/cell-map.md; VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md. Cell values re-confirmed live via MATLAB readcell 2026-07-21 during this JSON-authoring phase (full-precision reads shown where they refine the readme's rounded figures).

fuselage_S_wet.low_fi_source: Geom!B3 — '1/3 Cone and 2/3 Cylinder approximation' (Geom!C3 label text, confirmed live). Formula: D_avg=(max_w+max_h)/2, S_wet=(5/6)*pi*D_avg*L_fuse. readme_geom.md Section 4.1.
fuselage_S_wet.high_fi_source: Geom!D23 — trapezoidal frame-integration of per-frame perimeters. readme_geom.md Section 4.1. RESOLVED per VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md Finding 3 (2026-07-21 user decision): fuselage S_wet ground truth is Geom!B3 (low-fi) / Geom!D23 (high-fi) — NOT Geom!A3/A4, which are label cells (A3='Fuselage', A4='Exposed Engine Nacelles'), not a second fuselage-S_wet pair.

lifting_surface_S_wet_ft2._source: Geom!A11:C17 (full labeled table, header 'Exposed Lifting Surface Swet') / B14:B17 (value column) — confirmed live exact match, VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md Finding 2.

pitch_control_HT.label: Exposed Pitch Trim Surface Wetted Area

lifting_surface_exposed_areas._source: Geom!A5:I10 — 'Exposed Lifting Surf Geometry' table (header rows 5-6: Xexposed, Root Chord, Tip Chord, Span, Root Chord (exposed), Half Span (exposed), Exposed S; data rows 7-10 = Wing/Pitch Control Surface/Strake/Vertical Tail). Range confirmed live exact match, VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md Finding 1. Full row re-read live via MATLAB readcell 2026-07-21 (Scribe's companion docs, readme_geom.md Section 4.5's 'Surface parameters' table, only reproduced a partial subset of these columns for the cosine cross-section formula — this block carries the complete raw table).

whole_aircraft_S_wet_ft2.raw_buggy_source: Geom!B19 — KNOWN EXCEL BUG: strake wetted area is double-counted. Workbook formula Geom!B19 = D23+B4+B14+B15+B16+B17+K21 includes both B15 (strake S_wet) and K21 (strake-chine wetted-area term, also strake S_wet). readme_geom.md top-of-file note + Section 6.2. This is a documented audit exception, not a silent deviation.
whole_aircraft_S_wet_ft2.corrected_source: readme_geom.md Section 6.2 — corrected total with the double-counted strake term removed. This is the value the comparison report should target for whole-aircraft S_wet; up to 2% error (vs. the usual 1% target used elsewhere in readme_geom.md) is the documented audit exception, because the workbook formula itself is known-bad, not because of any modeling looseness.
whole_aircraft_S_wet_ft2.strake_chine_term_source: Geom!K21 — the strake-chine wetted-area term responsible for the B19 double-count. GroundTruth/cell-map.md.

nacelle._note: No nacelle S_wet/geometry component exists in the current GeomL1/L2 toolbox's get_S_wet aggregation (wing+HT+VT+fuselage[+duct, folded into L2 per the 2026-07-22 L3-elimination decision] only) — recorded here as a Brandt ground-truth figure for possible future comparison use (e.g. once a nacelle component or the D=sqrt(T_AB_SLS/1900) duct-diameter formula referenced by geometry_L2.json's engine block is implemented), not a value any current toolbox method should be checked against yet.
nacelle.S_wet_source: Geom!B4 — 'Exposed Engine Nacelles' (Geom!C4 label: 'Full Cylinder approximation'). readme_geom.md Section 4.4 — cell formula itself could not be confirmed from the binary .xls; this GT value is used as-is.
nacelle.diameter_source: Engn(s) tab: D_engine = sqrt(T_AB_SLS_lb / 1900) = sqrt(23770/1900). readme_geom.md Section 3; GroundTruth/cell-map.md 'Engn(s)' section (Engn!D_nac).
nacelle.length_source: Engn(s) tab: L_engine = 4.5 * D_engine. readme_geom.md Section 3; GroundTruth/cell-map.md 'Engn(s)' section (Engn!L_nac).

aircraft_length_ft.source: Geom!B21 ('Total Aircraft Length:' label). Confirmed live 2026-07-21. readme_geom.md Section 8, Table 2 cites the rounded figure 48.304 ft.

Amax_ft2.source: Geom!B20 ('Total Aircraft Amax:' label) and Geom!H47 (same value per GroundTruth/cell-map.md) — both cells confirmed live 2026-07-21 to read 25.1106 ft2, not a conflict (B20 appears to reference/duplicate H47's computation). Derivation per readme_geom.md Section 4.5: Amax = MAX(H26:H45) - N_eng*pi*D_eng^2/5.0 = 32.971 - pi*3.537^2/5.0 = 25.110 ft2.

wing_sweep_25pct_chord_deg.source: readme_geom.md Section 8, Table 3 validation entry ('Wing sweep 25%c'). Not tied to a single raw Excel cell — a validated BrandtGeometry.m-computed check value (readme_geom.md gives no _row/cell citation for this specific entry, unlike most other Table entries). Useful future comparison target for the new Base-tier sweep-conversion (convert_sweep) method once implemented — see src/base/GeometryBase.md Task 2 (citation for the sweep-conversion identity itself is documented there as unresolved/uncited, per user decision).

aerodynamics._comment: Brandt = his workbook's own model outputs/predictions and (for the polar-vs-Mach table) his tabulated actual F-16 reference polar; AF-Manual = T.O. 1F-16A-1 limits/airfoil (very few coefficients -- the drag polar / CLmax / CD0 are NOT in this manual, see _af_manual_note); internet = published estimates (many are estimates, flagged in each _note). Compare framework output to these; never treat a Brandt-model output as an independent second ground truth (see VnV/BrandtF16A/todo.md 2026-07-22 Finding D).
aerodynamics._source: readme_aero.md 'Ground-Truth Cross-Check Values' + Aero/Miss-tab cell refs (Brandt); T.O. 1F-16A-1 (AF-manual, scribe PDF read); cited publications (internet).

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss!CD0_cruise (readme_aero.md Ground-Truth table). Uses the back-calculated Cfe_eff=0.005908 that folds in form/interference/wave drag.

internet._source: 'Aerodynamic Performance Analysis of F-16C' (ResearchGate). F-16C conceptual polar CD=0.01667+0.1167*CL^2-0.009*CL.
internet._note: ESTIMATE. Brandt's own textbook polar ('Introduction to Aeronautics: A Design Perspective') instead gives CD0=0.018 (CD=0.018+0.117*CL^2).

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss!CD0_TO (readme_aero.md). Clean CD0 + gear/flap increment.
Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss!k1 (readme_aero.md). Quadratic / induced term (CD = CD0 + k1*CL^2 + k2*CL).

internet._source: 'Aerodynamic Performance Analysis of F-16C' (ResearchGate), quadratic coefficient.

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss!k2 (computed, Aero!G17 = -2*k1*CL0). readme_aero.md. Linear / camber term.

internet._source: 'Aerodynamic Performance Analysis of F-16C' (ResearchGate), linear CL term of CD=0.01667+0.1167*CL^2-0.009*CL.

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss!LD_max (readme_aero.md). Brandt simplified 0.5/sqrt(CD0*k1), ignoring k2, on the mission CD0=0.0270 basis.

internet._source: Brandt, 'Introduction to Aeronautics: A Design Perspective' textbook polar (CD=0.018+0.117*CL^2) -> LDmax=10.9.
internet._note: ESTIMATE; published clean subsonic L/Dmax band ~10.4-10.9. Higher than Brandt-workbook 8.93 because it uses the lower textbook CD0=0.018 vs the mission CD0=0.0270.

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Miss!CL_opt = sqrt(CD0/k1) (readme_aero.md). CL at max L/D on the mission polar.

internet._source: Brandt textbook polar (CD=0.018+0.117*CL^2) -> CL at L/Dmax = 0.39.
internet._note: ESTIMATE; lower because it uses the textbook CD0=0.018.

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!G12 = max(0.4, 4.6*(1-0.033*AR^0.53)*cos(Lambda_LE)^0.1 - 3.3). readme_aero.md. Brandt's own Oswald formula (differs from Raymer Eq 12.48/12.49).

internet._note: ESTIMATE; F-16C ResearchGate polar gives e~0.91.

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!A19 = max(0.6, 2/(2-AR+sqrt(4+AR^2*(1+tan^2(Lambda_avg))))). readme_aero.md. Brandt's per-surface span-efficiency (distinct from e0).
Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!A28 (same formula/value as e_wing, for the stabilator). readme_aero.md.

Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!G3 = Cfe_tab*S_wet/S_ref (Aero-tab basis, Cfe_tab=0.0037). readme_aero.md. This is Brandt's pure skin-friction prediction (used by aero_at_mach), distinct from the Miss-tab CD0=0.0270 mission basis.
Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!A12 = 1 - 0.065*(cos(Lambda_LE)*tc_pct)^0.6. readme_aero.md. Computed by Brandt's own formula, not a T.O. number (todo.md Finding D).
Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!F9 = sec(Lambda_LE) = 1/cos(40deg). readme_aero.md. Above this Mach the wing LE is supersonic.
Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!L31 = max(0, S_ref - outboard_strip - inboard_strip) = 300.0 - 51.49 - 103.77. readme_aero.md CLmax Step 2.
Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!H25 = CLalpha_total[/deg]*alpha_stall = 0.06150*16. readme_aero.md CLmax Step 1.

internet._source: NASA TP-1538 / DAVE-ML F16_aero model / Stevens and Lewis, 'Aircraft Control and Simulation'.
internet._note: ESTIMATE; published whole-aircraft clean CLmax band ~1.6-1.9 (much higher than Brandt's 0.984, which is a conservative camber-digit-based estimate).

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!H27 = CLmax_clean + 0.66*(CLmax_landing - CLmax_clean). readme_aero.md CLmax Step 5.

internet._note: ESTIMATE ONLY -- the F-16 has no conventional trailing-edge flaps (flaperons + LE flaps only); no authoritative published takeoff CLmax. Midpoint 1.35 recorded as a rough band center.

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!H29 = min(CLmax_trim, CLmax_from_flaps) = min(1.537, 1.426). readme_aero.md CLmax Step 5.

internet._note: ESTIMATE ONLY -- same caveat as CLmax_takeoff (no conventional TE flaps).

brandt._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!A32 (whole-aircraft, incl. strake + tail contributions). readme_aero.md. Brandt Helmbold-formula output, not independent data (todo.md Finding D).
Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!A15 = 0.1/(1+5.73/(pi*e*AR)) (Helmbold-like, per deg). readme_aero.md. Brandt-model output (todo.md Finding D).

internet._source: Published NACA 64A204 section lift-curve slope ~0.10-0.11/deg (thin-airfoil theory 2*pi/rad=0.1097/deg brackets it).
internet._note: ESTIMATE; 2-D section value (distinct from the whole-aircraft/finite-wing CL_alpha above). Midpoint 0.105 recorded.

internet._source: Published F-16 supersonic CD0 ~0.04-0.045 near M~1.05.
internet._note: ESTIMATE; band center. Compare vs Brandt's tabulated actual polar CDo=0.0444 at M=1.05 (brandt_actual_polar_vs_mach).

brandt_actual_polar_vs_mach._source: Brandt-F16-A.xls Aero!M4:Q10 -- the tabulated ACTUAL/reference F-16A polar (measured or authoritative reference data, NOT Brandt-predicted), five Mach points. readme_aero.md 'F-16A Specific Values'. CDmin ~= CDo at all points (very low wing camber). This IS reference data, unlike Brandt's predicted polar.

internet_reference_polars._note: Full published quadratic drag polars, recorded for reference. ESTIMATES; do not backfill unit-test expected values from these.

brandt_textbook._source: Brandt et al., 'Introduction to Aeronautics: A Design Perspective' (textbook example polar).

af_manual._source: T.O. 1F-16A-1, Flight Manual, USAF/EPAF F-16A/B Blocks 10 and 15 (scribe PDF read, Aero deep-dive Phase A). Section I / Figure 1-2 (airfoil), operating-limits pages.
af_manual._af_manual_note: T.O. 1F-16A-1 contains almost no aerodynamic COEFFICIENTS -- the drag polar, CLmax, and CD0 are NOT in it; they live in the separate T.O. 1F-16A-1-1 performance-data supplement, which is NOT in the repo. Only limits and the airfoil designation are AF-manual ground truth.

airfoil._source: T.O. 1F-16A-1 Fig. 1-2 (wing, root and tip). Cross-confirmed usaf_f16_data.md line 30.

AoA_range_deg._source: T.O. 1F-16A-1 -- AoA indicator range -5 to 32 deg; controllable range -5 to 25 deg.
